Interface IPHlpAPI.UDP_TABLE_CLASS

Enclosing interface:
IPHlpAPI
public static interface IPHlpAPI.UDP_TABLE_CLASS
Defines the set of values used to indicate the type of table returned by calls to IPHlpAPI.GetExtendedUdpTable(Pointer, IntByReference, boolean, int, int, int).
